dependencies.name: feya_commerce_v_query_cluster_proposal_candidates_v1
dependencies.definition:
WITH latest_approved_cleanup AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.keyword_norm) c.cleanup_id,
            c.keyword_id,
            c.keyword_norm,
            c.approved_keyword,
            c.approved_keyword_norm,
            c.keyword_axis,
            c.keyword_pattern,
            c.suggested_page_level,
            c.ai_intent,
            c.should_use_for_product,
            c.should_use_for_collection,
            c.should_use_for_image_alt,
            c.approved_at
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_v1 c
          WHERE ((c.review_status = 'approved'::text) AND (c.approved_keyword_norm IS NOT NULL))
          ORDER BY c.keyword_norm, c.approved_at DESC NULLS LAST, c.cleanup_id DESC
        ), membership AS (
         SELECT m_1.keyword_norm,
            (count(*))::integer AS active_membership_count
           FROM (feya_commerce_seo_query_cluster_members_v1 m_1
             JOIN feya_commerce_seo_query_clusters_v1 c ON ((c.query_cluster_id = m_1.query_cluster_id)))
          WHERE ((m_1.member_role <> 'excluded'::text) AND (c.cluster_status = ANY (ARRAY['review'::text, 'approved'::text, 'hold'::text])))
          GROUP BY m_1.keyword_norm
        ), latest_metric AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.keyword_norm) s.keyword_norm,
            s.avg_monthly_searches,
            s.competition,
            s.competition_index,
            s.fetched_at,
            s.data_freshness_status
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1 s
          WHERE ((COALESCE(s.geo, 'US'::text) = 'US'::text) AND (COALESCE(s.language, 'en'::text) = 'en'::text))
          ORDER BY s.keyword_norm, s.fetched_at DESC NULLS LAST, s.snapshot_id DESC
        )
 SELECT a.cleanup_id,
    a.keyword_id,
    a.keyword_norm,
    a.approved_keyword,
    a.approved_keyword_norm,
    a.keyword_axis,
    a.keyword_pattern,
    a.suggested_page_level,
    a.ai_intent,
    a.should_use_for_product,
    a.should_use_for_collection,
    a.should_use_for_image_alt,
    a.approved_at,
    COALESCE(m.active_membership_count, 0) AS active_membership_count,
    lm.avg_monthly_searches,
    lm.competition,
    lm.competition_index,
    lm.fetched_at AS metric_fetched_at,
    lm.data_freshness_status AS metric_freshness_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(m.active_membership_count, 0) > 0) THEN 'ALREADY_CLUSTERED'::text
            WHEN (a.approved_keyword_norm IS NULL) THEN 'NOT_READY'::text
            ELSE 'READY_FOR_CLUSTER_PROPOSAL'::text
        END AS proposal_candidate_status
   FROM ((latest_approved_cleanup a
     LEFT JOIN membership m ON ((m.keyword_norm = a.keyword_norm)))
     LEFT JOIN latest_metric lm ON ((lm.keyword_norm = a.keyword_norm)));

dependencies.name: feya_commerce_v_query_cluster_review_queue_v1
dependencies.definition:
WITH latest_cleanup AS (
         SELECT c.cleanup_id,
            c.run_id,
            c.keyword_id,
            c.keyword_norm,
            c.original_keyword,
            c.cleaned_keyword,
            c.suggested_keyword,
            c.keyword_axis,
            c.keyword_pattern,
            c.suggested_page_level,
            c.ai_intent,
            c.ai_rewrite_status,
            c.should_validate_api,
            c.should_use_for_product,
            c.should_use_for_collection,
            c.should_use_for_image_alt,
            c.should_hold,
            c.warning_flags,
            c.ai_reason,
            c.model_name,
            c.prompt_version,
            c.source_queue_snapshot,
            c.raw_ai_response_json,
            c.review_status,
            c.approved_keyword,
            c.approved_keyword_norm,
            c.approved_at,
            c.approved_by,
            c.created_at,
            c.updated_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.keyword_norm ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.cleanup_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_ai_cleanup_v1 c
        ), latest_metric AS (
         SELECT s.snapshot_id,
            s.keyword_norm,
            s.source_api,
            s.geo,
            s.language,
            s.avg_monthly_searches,
            s.competition,
            s.competition_index,
            s.low_top_of_page_bid,
            s.high_top_of_page_bid,
            s.monthly_search_volumes_json,
            s.fetched_at,
            s.raw_payload_json,
            s.data_freshness_status,
            s.created_at,
            s.metric_batch_id,
            s.metric_batch_keyword_id,
            s.keyword_id,
            s.source_request_id,
            s.api_version,
            s.ingestion_run_id,
            s.targeting_context_hash,
            s.access_model,
            s.bid_currency_code,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.keyword_norm, COALESCE(s.geo, 'US'::text), COALESCE(s.language, 'en'::text) ORDER BY s.fetched_at DESC NULLS LAST, s.snapshot_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1 s
        ), cluster_membership AS (
         SELECT m.keyword_norm,
            (count(*))::integer AS cluster_membership_count
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_query_cluster_members_v1 m
          WHERE (m.member_role <> 'excluded'::text)
          GROUP BY m.keyword_norm
        )
 SELECT km.keyword_id,
    km.keyword AS source_keyword,
    km.keyword_norm,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(lc.approved_keyword, ''::text), NULLIF(lc.suggested_keyword, ''::text), NULLIF(lc.cleaned_keyword, ''::text), km.keyword) AS semantic_keyword_candidate,
    km.keyword_axis,
    km.keyword_pattern,
    km.suggested_page_level,
    km.priority_tier,
    km.validation_priority,
    km.validation_status AS keyword_master_validation_status,
    km.requires_api_validation,
    km.product_count,
    lc.cleanup_id,
    lc.ai_intent,
    lc.ai_rewrite_status,
    lc.review_status AS cleanup_review_status,
    lc.should_validate_api,
    lc.should_use_for_product,
    lc.should_use_for_collection,
    lc.should_use_for_image_alt,
    lc.should_hold,
    lc.warning_flags,
    lm.avg_monthly_searches,
    lm.competition,
    lm.competition_index,
    lm.fetched_at AS latest_metric_fetched_at,
    lm.data_freshness_status AS metric_data_freshness_status,
    COALESCE(cm.cluster_membership_count, 0) AS cluster_membership_count,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(lc.should_hold, false) IS TRUE) THEN 'HOLD'::text
            WHEN (lc.cleanup_id IS NULL) THEN 'NEEDS_CLEANUP'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(lc.review_status, 'pending'::text) <> 'approved'::text) THEN 'NEEDS_CLEANUP_REVIEW'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(cm.cluster_membership_count, 0) > 0) THEN 'ALREADY_CLUSTERED'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(lc.should_validate_api, km.requires_api_validation, false) IS TRUE) AND ((lm.snapshot_id IS NULL) OR (COALESCE(lm.data_freshness_status, ''::text) = ANY (ARRAY['api_not_connected'::text, 'placeholder'::text, 'mock'::text, 'no_real_metrics'::text])) OR ((lm.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) AND (lm.competition IS NULL) AND (lm.competition_index IS NULL)) OR (lm.fetched_at IS NULL) OR (lm.fetched_at < (now() - '90 days'::interval)))) THEN 'WAIT_FOR_METRICS'::text
            ELSE 'READY_FOR_SEMANTIC_CLUSTERING'::text
        END AS cluster_queue_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (km.suggested_page_level = 'product'::text) THEN 'PRODUCT_INTENT_FAMILY'::text
            WHEN (km.suggested_page_level = 'collection'::text) THEN 'COLLECTION_INTENT_FAMILY'::text
            WHEN (km.suggested_page_level = 'image_alt'::text) THEN 'IMAGE_SEMANTIC_SUPPORT'::text
            ELSE 'UNCLASSIFIED'::text
        END AS clustering_lane,
    jsonb_build_object('axis', km.keyword_axis, 'pattern', km.keyword_pattern, 'suggested_page_level', km.suggested_page_level, 'priority_tier', km.priority_tier, 'product_count', km.product_count, 'cleanup_review_status', lc.review_status, 'ai_intent', lc.ai_intent, 'avg_monthly_searches', lm.avg_monthly_searches, 'metric_fetched_at', lm.fetched_at, 'metric_freshness', lm.data_freshness_status) AS clustering_evidence
   FROM (((feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1 km
     LEFT JOIN latest_cleanup lc ON (((lc.keyword_norm = km.keyword_norm) AND (lc.rn = 1))))
     LEFT JOIN latest_metric lm ON (((lm.keyword_norm = km.keyword_norm) AND (COALESCE(lm.geo, 'US'::text) = 'US'::text) AND (COALESCE(lm.language, 'en'::text) = 'en'::text) AND (lm.rn = 1))))
     LEFT JOIN cluster_membership cm ON ((cm.keyword_norm = km.keyword_norm)))
  WHERE (km.active_flag IS TRUE);

dependencies.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_api_validation_pilot_report_v1
dependencies.definition:
WITH snapshots AS (
         SELECT feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.snapshot_id,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.keyword_norm,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.source_api,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.geo,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.language,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.avg_monthly_searches,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.competition,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.competition_index,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.low_top_of_page_bid,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.high_top_of_page_bid,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.monthly_search_volumes_json,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.fetched_at,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.raw_payload_json,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.data_freshness_status,
            feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.created_at
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1
          WHERE ((feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.source_api = 'google_ads_keyword_planner'::text) AND (feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.geo = 'US'::text) AND (feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.language = 'en'::text) AND ((feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1.raw_payload_json ->> 'pilot_run'::text) = 'us_en_tier1_controlled_150'::text))
        ), summary AS (
         SELECT 'summary'::text AS section,
            'pilot_snapshot_rows'::text AS metric,
            NULL::text AS keyword_norm,
            (count(*))::numeric AS value,
            NULL::text AS details
           FROM snapshots
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'metrics_received'::text,
            NULL::text,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (snapshots.avg_monthly_searches IS NOT NULL)))::numeric AS count,
            NULL::text
           FROM snapshots
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'api_not_connected'::text,
            NULL::text,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (snapshots.data_freshness_status = 'api_not_connected'::text)))::numeric AS count,
            NULL::text
           FROM snapshots
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'summary'::text,
            'errors'::text,
            NULL::text,
            (0)::numeric AS "numeric",
            'No API call was made; Google Ads API tool/credentials unavailable in this session.'::text
        ), top_prepared AS (
         SELECT 'prepared_batch'::text AS section,
            m.keyword AS metric,
            m.keyword_norm,
            (m.product_count)::numeric AS value,
            ((((m.keyword_axis || ' / '::text) || m.keyword_pattern) || ' / '::text) || m.priority_tier) AS details
           FROM (feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1 m
             JOIN snapshots s ON ((s.keyword_norm = m.keyword_norm)))
          ORDER BY m.product_count DESC, m.keyword
         LIMIT 150
        )
 SELECT summary.section,
    summary.metric,
    summary.keyword_norm,
    summary.value,
    summary.details
   FROM summary
UNION ALL
 SELECT top_prepared.section,
    top_prepared.metric,
    top_prepared.keyword_norm,
    top_prepared.value,
    top_prepared.details
   FROM top_prepared;

dependencies.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_candidate_promotion_dry_run_v2
dependencies.definition:
WITH listing_master_norms AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT vw_seo_keyword_bank_v1_for_listing_master.keyword_norm
           FROM vw_seo_keyword_bank_v1_for_listing_master
        ), bank_best_ranked AS (
         SELECT b.id,
            b.keyword,
            b.keyword_norm,
            b.bank_bucket,
            b.review_status,
            b.source_clusters,
            b.score,
            b.avg_monthly_searches,
            b.competition,
            b.competition_index,
            b.low_bid,
            b.high_bid,
            b.region,
            b.language,
            b.metric_source,
            b.page_type,
            b.role,
            b.role_label,
            b.last_checked,
            b.duplicate_count,
            b.reason,
            b.notes,
            b.source_files,
            b.created_at,
            b.updated_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY b.keyword_norm ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN (lm.keyword_norm IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END,
                CASE b.review_status
                    WHEN 'approved_draft'::text THEN 1
                    WHEN 'hold'::text THEN 2
                    WHEN 'reject'::text THEN 3
                    ELSE 9
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.bank_bucket = ANY (ARRAY['product'::text, 'product_or_alt'::text, 'collection'::text, 'commercial_collection'::text, 'visual_collection'::text, 'faq'::text])) THEN 1
                    ELSE 9
                END, b.score DESC NULLS LAST, b.avg_monthly_searches DESC NULLS LAST, b.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, b.keyword) AS rn
           FROM (seo_keyword_bank_v1 b
             LEFT JOIN listing_master_norms lm ON ((lm.keyword_norm = b.keyword_norm)))
        ), bank_best AS (
         SELECT bank_best_ranked.id,
            bank_best_ranked.keyword,
            bank_best_ranked.keyword_norm,
            bank_best_ranked.bank_bucket,
            bank_best_ranked.review_status,
            bank_best_ranked.source_clusters,
            bank_best_ranked.score,
            bank_best_ranked.avg_monthly_searches,
            bank_best_ranked.competition,
            bank_best_ranked.competition_index,
            bank_best_ranked.low_bid,
            bank_best_ranked.high_bid,
            bank_best_ranked.region,
            bank_best_ranked.language,
            bank_best_ranked.metric_source,
            bank_best_ranked.page_type,
            bank_best_ranked.role,
            bank_best_ranked.role_label,
            bank_best_ranked.last_checked,
            bank_best_ranked.duplicate_count,
            bank_best_ranked.reason,
            bank_best_ranked.notes,
            bank_best_ranked.source_files,
            bank_best_ranked.created_at,
            bank_best_ranked.updated_at,
            bank_best_ranked.rn
           FROM bank_best_ranked
          WHERE (bank_best_ranked.rn = 1)
        ), latest_staging_ranked AS (
         SELECT regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS keyword_norm_clean,
            s.import_row_id,
            s.batch_code,
            s.keyword,
            s.keyword_norm,
            s.geo,
            s.language,
            s.avg_monthly_searches,
            upper(NULLIF(s.competition, ''::text)) AS competition,
            s.competition_index,
            s.low_top_of_page_bid,
            s.high_top_of_page_bid,
            s.monthly_search_volumes_raw,
            s.source_file_name,
            s.imported_at,
            s.import_status,
            s.import_note,
            "substring"(COALESCE(s.monthly_search_volumes_raw, ''::text), '"source_row_type"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"'::text) AS source_row_type_from_raw,
            "substring"(COALESCE(s.monthly_search_volumes_raw, ''::text), '"currency"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"'::text) AS bid_currency_from_raw,
            "substring"(COALESCE(s.monthly_search_volumes_raw, ''::text), '"metric_source"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"'::text) AS metric_source_from_raw,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY (regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN (s.avg_monthly_searches IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END, s.imported_at DESC NULLS LAST, s.import_row_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1 s
          WHERE (NULLIF(regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)
        ), latest_staging AS (
         SELECT latest_staging_ranked.keyword_norm_clean,
            latest_staging_ranked.import_row_id,
            latest_staging_ranked.batch_code,
            latest_staging_ranked.keyword,
            latest_staging_ranked.keyword_norm,
            latest_staging_ranked.geo,
            latest_staging_ranked.language,
            latest_staging_ranked.avg_monthly_searches,
            latest_staging_ranked.competition,
            latest_staging_ranked.competition_index,
            latest_staging_ranked.low_top_of_page_bid,
            latest_staging_ranked.high_top_of_page_bid,
            latest_staging_ranked.monthly_search_volumes_raw,
            latest_staging_ranked.source_file_name,
            latest_staging_ranked.imported_at,
            latest_staging_ranked.import_status,
            latest_staging_ranked.import_note,
            latest_staging_ranked.source_row_type_from_raw,
            latest_staging_ranked.bid_currency_from_raw,
            latest_staging_ranked.metric_source_from_raw,
            latest_staging_ranked.rn
           FROM latest_staging_ranked
          WHERE (latest_staging_ranked.rn = 1)
        ), latest_snapshot_ranked AS (
         SELECT regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(m.keyword_norm, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS keyword_norm_clean,
            m.snapshot_id,
            m.keyword_norm,
            m.source_api,
            m.geo,
            m.language,
            m.avg_monthly_searches,
            upper(NULLIF(m.competition, ''::text)) AS competition,
            m.competition_index,
            m.low_top_of_page_bid,
            m.high_top_of_page_bid,
            m.fetched_at,
            m.raw_payload_json,
            m.data_freshness_status,
            (m.raw_payload_json ->> 'batch_code'::text) AS source_batch,
            NULLIF((m.raw_payload_json ->> 'source_row_type'::text), ''::text) AS source_row_type_from_snapshot,
            NULLIF((m.raw_payload_json ->> 'currency'::text), ''::text) AS bid_currency_from_snapshot,
            NULLIF((m.raw_payload_json ->> 'metric_source'::text), ''::text) AS metric_source_from_snapshot,
            NULLIF((m.raw_payload_json ->> 'source_file_name'::text), ''::text) AS source_file_name_from_snapshot,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((m.raw_payload_json ->> 'import_row_id'::text) ~ '^[0-9]+$'::text) THEN ((m.raw_payload_json ->> 'import_row_id'::text))::bigint
                    ELSE NULL::bigint
                END AS import_row_id_from_snapshot,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY (regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(m.keyword_norm, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN (m.avg_monthly_searches IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END, m.fetched_at DESC NULLS LAST, m.snapshot_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1 m
          WHERE (NULLIF(regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(m.keyword_norm, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)
        ), latest_snapshot AS (
         SELECT m.keyword_norm_clean,
            m.snapshot_id,
            m.keyword_norm,
            m.source_api,
            m.geo,
            m.language,
            m.avg_monthly_searches,
            m.competition,
            m.competition_index,
            m.low_top_of_page_bid,
            m.high_top_of_page_bid,
            m.fetched_at,
            m.raw_payload_json,
            m.data_freshness_status,
            m.source_batch,
            m.source_row_type_from_snapshot,
            m.bid_currency_from_snapshot,
            m.metric_source_from_snapshot,
            m.source_file_name_from_snapshot,
            m.import_row_id_from_snapshot,
            m.rn,
            st.batch_code AS staging_batch_code,
            st.keyword AS staging_keyword,
            st.source_row_type_from_raw AS staging_source_row_type,
            st.bid_currency_from_raw AS staging_bid_currency,
            st.metric_source_from_raw AS staging_metric_source,
            st.source_file_name AS staging_source_file_name,
            st.monthly_search_volumes_raw AS staging_monthly_search_volumes_raw
           FROM (latest_snapshot_ranked m
             LEFT JOIN latest_staging st ON ((st.import_row_id = m.import_row_id_from_snapshot)))
          WHERE (m.rn = 1)
        ), old_master_ranked AS (
         SELECT regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(m.keyword_norm, m.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS keyword_norm_clean,
            m.keyword_id,
            m.keyword,
            m.keyword_norm,
            m.keyword_axis,
            m.keyword_pattern,
            m.suggested_page_level,
            m.priority_tier,
            m.validation_priority,
            m.validation_status,
            m.reason,
            m.source,
            m.first_seen_at,
            m.last_seen_at,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY (regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(m.keyword_norm, m.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) ORDER BY m.last_seen_at DESC NULLS LAST, m.keyword_id DESC) AS rn
           FROM feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1 m
          WHERE ((m.active_flag IS TRUE) AND (NULLIF(regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(m.keyword_norm, m.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text), ''::text) IS NOT NULL))
        ), old_master AS (
         SELECT old_master_ranked.keyword_norm_clean,
            old_master_ranked.keyword_id,
            old_master_ranked.keyword,
            old_master_ranked.keyword_norm,
            old_master_ranked.keyword_axis,
            old_master_ranked.keyword_pattern,
            old_master_ranked.suggested_page_level,
            old_master_ranked.priority_tier,
            old_master_ranked.validation_priority,
            old_master_ranked.validation_status,
            old_master_ranked.reason,
            old_master_ranked.source,
            old_master_ranked.first_seen_at,
            old_master_ranked.last_seen_at,
            old_master_ranked.rn
           FROM old_master_ranked
          WHERE (old_master_ranked.rn = 1)
        ), bank_import_ranked AS (
         SELECT regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS keyword_norm_clean,
            s.keyword,
            s.keyword_norm,
            s.bank_bucket,
            s.review_status,
            s.source_clusters,
            s.page_type,
            s.role,
            s.role_label,
            s.reason,

        ), flags AS (

            ((e.match_text ~~ '%gold%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%silver%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%mirror%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%metallic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%reflective%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%holographic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%chrome%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%leather%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%acrylic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%black%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%white%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%iridescent%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%shiny%'::text)) AS has_material_color,
            ((e.match_text ~~ '%rave%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%edm%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%festival%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%burning man%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%coachella%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%stage%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%performance%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%drag%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%clubwear%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dancer%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dance%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%futuristic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%cyberpunk%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%apocalyptic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%post apocalyptic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%desert%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%cosmic%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%sci fi%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%sci-fi%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%punk%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%glam%'::text)) AS has_event_style,
            ((e.match_text ~~ '%outfit%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%costume%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dress%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '% set%'::text)) AS has_visual_product_word,
            ((e.match_text ~~ '%price%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%cost%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%shipping%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%delivery%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%size%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%sizing%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%how to%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%what to wear%'::text)) AS is_faq_intent,
            ((e.match_text ~~ '%buy%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%shop%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%order%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%custom%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%handmade%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%for sale%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%online%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%website%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%store%'::text)) AS is_commercial_intent,
            to_jsonb(array_remove(ARRAY[
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%lego%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%pokemon%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%pokémon%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%barbie%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%disney%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%wonder woman%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%batman%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%harry potter%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%star wars%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%mandalorian%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%spongebob%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%shrek%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%my little pony%'::text)) THEN 'franchise_brand'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%kids%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '% child%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%children%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%baby%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%toddler%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dog costume%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%pet costume%'::text)) THEN 'kids_pet'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text

                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%bridal%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%bride%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%wedding%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%bridesmaid%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%prom%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%homecoming%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%flapper%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%gatsby%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%renaissance%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%medieval%'::text)) THEN 'wrong_occasion'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%n95%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%kn95%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%surgical mask%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%medical mask%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%respirator%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%dust mask%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%gas mask%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%protective face mask%'::text)) THEN 'medical_safety'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%fall protection%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%safety harness%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%climbing harness%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%wire harness%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%wiring harness%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%osha%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%ansi%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%lanyard%'::text)) THEN 'industrial_harness'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((e.match_text ~~ '%necklace%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%earrings%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%diamond%'::text) OR (e.match_text ~~ '%pearl jewelry%'::text)) THEN 'jewelry_only'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END], NULL::text)) AS block_flags
           FROM enriched e
        ), bucketed AS (
         SELECT f.candidate_keyword,
            f.candidate_keyword_norm,
            f.candidate_source,
            f.exists_in_bank,
            f.exists_in_listing_master,
            f.avg_monthly_searches,
            f.competition,
            f.competition_index,
            f.low_bid,
            f.high_bid,
            f.metric_source,
            f.metric_date,
            f.source_review_status,
            f.source_validation_status,
            f.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            f.source_bank_bucket,
            f.source_page_type,
            f.source_role,
            f.source_role_label,
            f.source_clusters,
            f.source_files,
            f.source_reason,
            f.source_notes,
            f.bank_review_status,
            f.bank_bucket,
            f.source_raw_json,
            f.match_text,
            f.has_metric,
            f.has_real_metric_signal,
            f.has_component,
            f.has_material_color,
            f.has_event_style,
            f.has_visual_product_word,
            f.is_faq_intent,
            f.is_commercial_intent,
            f.block_flags,
                CASE
                    WHEN f.is_faq_intent THEN 'faq'::text
                    WHEN f.is_commercial_intent THEN 'commercial_collection'::text
                    WHEN (f.has_component AND f.has_material_color) THEN 'product_or_alt'::text
                    WHEN f.has_component THEN 'product'::text
                    WHEN (f.has_material_color AND f.has_visual_product_word) THEN 'visual_collection'::text
                    WHEN f.has_event_style THEN 'collection'::text
                    ELSE 'hold'::text
                END AS proposed_bank_bucket
           FROM flags f
        ), decided AS (
         SELECT b.candidate_keyword,
            b.candidate_keyword_norm,
            b.candidate_source,
            b.exists_in_bank,
            b.exists_in_listing_master,
            b.avg_monthly_searches,
            b.competition,
            b.competition_index,
            b.low_bid,
            b.high_bid,
            b.metric_source,
            b.metric_date,
            b.source_review_status,
            b.source_validation_status,
            b.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            b.source_bank_bucket,
            b.source_page_type,
            b.source_role,
            b.source_role_label,
            b.source_clusters,
            b.source_files,
            b.source_reason,

            b.source_raw_json,
            b.match_text,

            b.is_commercial_intent,

            b.proposed_bank_bucket,
                CASE
                    WHEN (jsonb_array_length(b.block_flags) > 0) THEN 'reject'::text
                    WHEN b.exists_in_bank THEN b.bank_review_status
                    WHEN (NOT b.has_metric) THEN 'hold'::text
                    WHEN (b.proposed_bank_bucket = 'hold'::text) THEN 'hold'::text
                    WHEN ((COALESCE(b.avg_monthly_searches, 0) = 0) AND (b.competition IS NULL)) THEN 'hold'::text
                    WHEN (NOT b.has_real_metric_signal) THEN 'hold'::text
                    ELSE 'approved_draft'::text
                END AS proposed_review_status
           FROM bucketed b
        ), actioned AS (
         SELECT d.candidate_keyword,
            d.candidate_keyword_norm,
            d.candidate_source,
            d.exists_in_bank,
            d.exists_in_listing_master,
            d.avg_monthly_searches,
            d.competition,
            d.competition_index,
            d.low_bid,
            d.high_bid,
            d.metric_source,
            d.metric_date,
            d.source_review_status,
            d.source_validation_status,
            d.cleanup_pipeline_status,
            d.source_bank_bucket,
            d.source_page_type,
            d.source_role,
            d.source_role_label,
            d.source_clusters,
            d.source_files,
            d.source_reason,
            d.source_notes,
            d.bank_review_status,
            d.bank_bucket,
            d.source_raw_json,
            d.match_text,
            d.has_metric,
            d.has_real_metric_signal,
            d.has_component,
            d.has_material_color,
            d.has_event_style,
            d.has_visual_product_word,
            d.is_faq_intent,
            d.is_commercial_intent,
            d.block_flags,
            d.proposed_bank_bucket,
            d.proposed_review_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN d.exists_in_bank THEN 'excluded_duplicate'::text
                    WHEN (jsonb_array_length(d.block_flags) > 0) THEN 'excluded_noise'::text
                    WHEN (NOT d.has_metric) THEN 'needs_manual_review_no_metric'::text
                    WHEN (d.proposed_bank_bucket = 'hold'::text) THEN 'needs_manual_review_bucket'::text
                    WHEN (((d.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) AND (d.competition IS NULL) AND (d.competition_index IS NULL) AND (d.low_bid IS NULL) AND (d.high_bid IS NULL)) OR ((COALESCE(d.avg_monthly_searches, 0) = 0) AND (d.competition IS NULL))) THEN 'needs_manual_review_zero_metric'::text
                    WHEN (d.proposed_review_status = 'approved_draft'::text) THEN 'would_insert'::text
                    ELSE 'needs_manual_review_bucket'::text
                END AS dry_run_action
           FROM decided d
        )
 SELECT candidate_keyword,
    candidate_keyword_norm,
    candidate_source,
    exists_in_bank,
    exists_in_listing_master,
    has_metric,
    avg_monthly_searches,
    competition,
    competition_index,
    low_bid,
    high_bid,
    metric_source,
    metric_date,
    source_review_status,
    source_validation_status,
    cleanup_pipeline_status,
    source_bank_bucket,
    source_page_type,
    source_role,
    source_role_label,
    proposed_bank_bucket,
    proposed_review_status,
    block_flags,
    dry_run_action,
        CASE
            WHEN (dry_run_action = 'excluded_duplicate'::text) THEN 'Уже есть в canonical seo_keyword_bank_v1; не вставлять повторно.'::text
            WHEN (dry_run_action = 'excluded_noise'::text) THEN ('Исключено rule-based block flags: '::text || (block_flags)::text)
            WHEN (dry_run_action = 'needs_manual_review_no_metric'::text) THEN 'Нет метрик и нет metric source; сначала отправить на Google Ads / ручную проверку.'::text
            WHEN (dry_run_action = 'needs_manual_review_bucket'::text) THEN 'Не удалось уверенно определить валидный bucket; нужен ручной review.'::text
            WHEN (dry_run_action = 'needs_manual_review_zero_metric'::text) THEN 'Метрика пустая или нулевая; не auto-approve.'::text
            WHEN (dry_run_action = 'would_insert'::text) THEN 'Чистый кандидат: не дубликат, без block flags, есть метрики, bucket валиден; можно готовить guarded insert.'::text
            ELSE 'Нужен ручной review.'::text
        END AS reason,
    source_clusters,
    source_files,
    source_reason,
    source_notes,
    (source_raw_json || jsonb_build_object('exists_in_bank', exists_in_bank, 'exists_in_listing_master', exists_in_listing_master, 'has_metric', has_metric, 'has_real_metric_signal', has_real_metric_signal, 'bank_review_status', bank_review_status, 'bank_bucket', bank_bucket, 'classification_flags', jsonb_build_object('has_component', has_component, 'has_material_color', has_material_color, 'has_event_style', has_event_style, 'is_faq_intent', is_faq_intent, 'is_commercial_intent', is_commercial_intent, 'has_visual_product_word', has_visual_product_word))) AS raw_json
   FROM actioned;

dependencies.definition:
SELECT s.import_row_id,
    s.batch_code,
    COALESCE(s.keyword, m.keyword) AS keyword,
    regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text) AS keyword_norm,
    s.geo,
    s.language,
    s.avg_monthly_searches,
        CASE
            WHEN (s.competition IS NULL) THEN NULL::text
            WHEN (lower(s.competition) = 'низкая'::text) THEN 'LOW'::text
            WHEN (lower(s.competition) = 'средняя'::text) THEN 'MEDIUM'::text
            WHEN (lower(s.competition) = 'высокая'::text) THEN 'HIGH'::text
            ELSE upper(s.competition)
        END AS competition,
    s.competition_index,
    s.low_top_of_page_bid,
    s.high_top_of_page_bid,
    s.monthly_search_volumes_raw,
    s.source_file_name,
    s.imported_at,
    s.import_status,
    s.import_note
   FROM ((feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1 s
     JOIN feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1 m ON (((m.keyword_norm = regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) AND (m.active_flag IS TRUE))))
     JOIN feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_validation_export_us_en_v1 e ON (((e.keyword_norm = m.keyword_norm) AND (e.batch_code = s.batch_code) AND (e.geo = s.geo) AND (e.language = s.language))))
  WHERE ((NULLIF(regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT ((s.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) AND (s.competition IS NULL) AND (s.competition_index IS NULL))) AND ((s.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) OR (s.avg_monthly_searches >= 0)) AND ((s.competition IS NULL) OR (lower(s.competition) = ANY (ARRAY['low'::text, 'medium'::text, 'high'::text, 'unknown'::text, 'низкая'::text, 'средняя'::text, 'высокая'::text]))));

WITH staging AS (

            m.keyword_id,
            m.keyword AS master_keyword,
            m.validation_status AS master_validation_status,
            m.priority_tier AS master_priority_tier,
            m.validation_priority AS master_validation_priority,
            e.keyword_norm AS export_keyword_norm
           FROM ((feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1 s
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_seo_keyword_master_v1 m ON (((m.keyword_norm = regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) AND (m.active_flag IS TRUE))))
             LEFT JOIN feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_validation_export_us_en_v1 e ON (((e.keyword_norm = regexp_replace(lower(btrim(COALESCE(s.keyword_norm, s.keyword, ''::text))), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)) AND (e.batch_code = s.batch_code) AND (e.geo = s.geo) AND (e.language = s.language))))
        ), row_checks AS (
         SELECT staging.import_row_id,
            staging.batch_code,
            staging.keyword,
            staging.keyword_norm,
            staging.geo,
            staging.language,
            staging.avg_monthly_searches,

            staging.keyword_id,
            staging.master_keyword,
            staging.master_validation_status,
            staging.master_priority_tier,
            staging.master_validation_priority,
            staging.export_keyword_norm,
                CASE
                    WHEN (NULLIF(staging.keyword_norm_clean, ''::text) IS NULL) THEN 'invalid_empty_keyword_norm'::text
                    WHEN (staging.keyword_id IS NULL) THEN 'not_matched_to_keyword_master'::text
                    WHEN (staging.export_keyword_norm IS NULL) THEN 'not_in_expected_export_batch'::text

                    ELSE 'ready_for_snapshot'::text
                END AS validation_result,
                CASE
                    WHEN (staging.keyword_id IS NULL) THEN true
                    WHEN (staging.export_keyword_norm IS NULL) THEN true
                    WHEN ((staging.avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) AND (staging.competition IS NULL) AND (staging.competition_index IS NULL)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((staging.competition IS NOT NULL) AND (lower(staging.competition) <> ALL (ARRAY['low'::text, 'medium'::text, 'high'::text, 'unknown'::text, 'низкая'::text, 'средняя'::text, 'высокая'::text]))) THEN true

           FROM staging

 SELECT c.cleanup_id,

          WHERE ((v2.source_batch IN ( SELECT p1_batches.batch_code
                   FROM p1_batches)) OR (v2.candidate_keyword_norm IN ( SELECT p1_metric_keywords.keyword_norm_clean
                   FROM p1_metric_keywords)))
        ), classified AS (
         SELECT b.candidate_keyword,

            b.p1_metric_date,
            b.current_bank_review_status,
            b.current_bank_bucket,
            b.current_page_type,
            b.current_visible_in_listing_master,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.exists_in_bank OR (b.dry_run_action = 'excluded_duplicate'::text)) THEN 'EXISTING_BANK_REVIEW'::text
                    WHEN (b.dry_run_action = 'would_insert'::text) THEN 'NEW_INSERT_CANDIDATE'::text
                    ELSE 'HOLD_OR_BLOCKED_REVIEW'::text
                END AS review_group,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.proposed_bank_bucket = ANY (ARRAY['product_or_alt'::text, 'product'::text, 'collection'::text, 'commercial_collection'::text, 'visual_collection'::text, 'faq'::text])) THEN b.proposed_bank_bucket
                    ELSE 'hold'::text
                END AS proposed_page_type_calc,
            ((b.dry_run_action = 'would_insert'::text) AND (COALESCE(b.p1_source_row_type, b.source_row_type) = 'input_seed'::text) AND (COALESCE(b.p1_avg_monthly_searches, b.avg_monthly_searches) IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(b.p1_competition, b.competition) IS NOT NULL) AND (upper(COALESCE(b.p1_competition, b.competition)) <> 'UNKNOWN'::text) AND (b.proposed_bank_bucket = ANY (ARRAY['product'::text, 'product_or_alt'::text, 'collection'::text, 'commercial_collection'::text, 'visual_collection'::text, 'faq'::text])) AND (COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(b.block_flags), 0) = 0) AND (b.exists_in_bank = false)) AS proposed_insert_allowed_calc
           FROM base b
        ), scored AS (
         SELECT c.candidate_keyword,
            c.candidate_keyword_norm,
            c.candidate_source,
            c.source_batch,
            c.source_row_type,
            c.exists_in_bank,
            c.exists_in_listing_master,
            c.has_metric,
            c.avg_monthly_searches,
            c.competition,
            c.competition_index,
            c.low_bid,
            c.high_bid,
            c.bid_currency,
            c.metric_source,

            c.source_review_status,
            c.source_validation_status,

            c.source_bank_bucket,
            c.source_page_type,
            c.source_role,
            c.source_role_label,
            c.proposed_bank_bucket,
            c.proposed_review_status,
            c.block_flags,
            c.dry_run_action,
            c.reason,
            c.source_clusters,
            c.source_files,
            c.source_reason,
            c.source_notes,
            c.raw_json,
            c.p1_source_batch,
            c.p1_source_row_type,
            c.p1_avg_monthly_searches,
            c.p1_competition,
            c.p1_competition_index,
            c.p1_low_bid,
            c.p1_high_bid,
            c.p1_bid_currency,
            c.p1_metric_source,
            c.p1_metric_date,
            c.current_bank_review_status,
            c.current_bank_bucket,
            c.current_page_type,
            c.current_visible_in_listing_master,
            c.review_group,
            c.proposed_page_type_calc,
            c.proposed_insert_allowed_calc,
            LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, ((((50 +
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(c.p1_avg_monthly_searches, c.avg_monthly_searches) >= 300) THEN 25
                    WHEN (COALESCE(c.p1_avg_monthly_searches, c.avg_monthly_searches) >= 100) THEN 18
                    WHEN (COALESCE(c.p1_avg_monthly_searches, c.avg_monthly_searches) >= 50) THEN 12
                    WHEN (COALESCE(c.p1_avg_monthly_searches, c.avg_monthly_searches) >= 20) THEN 8
                    WHEN (COALESCE(c.p1_avg_monthly_searches, c.avg_monthly_searches) >= 10) THEN 4
                    ELSE 0
                END) +
                CASE upper(COALESCE(c.p1_competition, c.competition, ''::text))
                    WHEN 'LOW'::text THEN 12
                    WHEN 'MEDIUM'::text THEN 8
                    WHEN 'HIGH'::text THEN 2
                    ELSE 0
                END) +
                CASE c.proposed_bank_bucket
                    WHEN 'product_or_alt'::text THEN 8
                    WHEN 'product'::text THEN 6
                    WHEN 'collection'::text THEN 4
                    ELSE 0
                END) +
                CASE COALESCE(c.p1_source_row_type, c.source_row_type)
                    WHEN 'input_seed'::text THEN 5
                    ELSE 0
                END))) AS proposed_score_calc
           FROM classified c
        )
 SELECT review_group,
    candidate_keyword,
    candidate_keyword_norm,
    p1_source_batch AS source_batch,
    COALESCE(p1_source_row_type, source_row_type) AS source_row_type,
    dry_run_action,
    exists_in_bank,
    exists_in_listing_master,
    proposed_insert_allowed_calc AS proposed_insert_allowed,
    proposed_bank_bucket,
    proposed_page_type_calc AS proposed_page_type,
        CASE

            WHEN (dry_run_action = ANY (ARRAY['needs_manual_review_no_metric'::text, 'needs_manual_review_zero_metric'::text])) THEN 'hold'::text

            WHEN exists_in_bank THEN COALESCE(current_bank_review_status, 'existing_bank_review'::text)
            ELSE COALESCE(proposed_review_status, 'hold'::text)
        END AS proposed_review_status,

    p1_avg_monthly_searches AS avg_monthly_searches,
    p1_competition AS competition,
    p1_competition_index AS competition_index,

    p1_low_bid AS low_bid,
    p1_high_bid AS high_bid,
    p1_metric_source AS metric_source,
    p1_metric_date AS metric_date,
        CASE
            WHEN ((p1_bid_currency IS NOT NULL) AND (p1_bid_currency <> 'USD'::text)) THEN 'UAH bids preserved for provenance only; do not copy to seo_keyword_bank_v1 until currency-aware logic exists'::text
            WHEN (p1_bid_currency IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Bid fields preserved for provenance only; promotion payload must not copy low_bid/high_bid in this dry-run'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS do_not_copy_bid_reason,
        CASE
            WHEN proposed_insert_allowed_calc THEN NULL::text
            WHEN (exists_in_bank OR (dry_run_action = 'excluded_duplicate'::text)) THEN 'already_exists_in_bank_no_insert'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(block_flags), 0) > 0) THEN ('blocked_by_flags: '::text || (block_flags)::text)
            WHEN (COALESCE(p1_source_row_type, source_row_type) = 'google_ads_related_idea'::text) THEN 'google_ads_related_idea_requires_manual_review'::text
            WHEN ((p1_avg_monthly_searches IS NULL) OR (p1_competition IS NULL) OR (upper(p1_competition) = 'UNKNOWN'::text)) THEN 'no_usable_metric'::text
            WHEN (proposed_bank_bucket <> ALL (ARRAY['product'::text, 'product_or_alt'::text, 'collection'::text, 'commercial_collection'::text, 'visual_collection'::text, 'faq'::text])) THEN 'unsafe_or_hold_bucket'::text
            WHEN (proposed_review_status = ANY (ARRAY['hold'::text, 'reject'::text])) THEN 'review_status_not_approved'::text
            ELSE 'not_allowed_by_guard'::text
        END AS insert_block_reason,
        CASE
            WHEN (exists_in_bank AND exists_in_listing_master) THEN 'already_visible_update_metrics_only'::text
            WHEN (exists_in_bank AND (NOT exists_in_listing_master)) THEN 'bank_exists_but_not_listing_master_check_status_bucket'::text
            ELSE 'not_existing'::text
        END AS existing_bank_review_action,
    reason,
    (raw_json || jsonb_build_object('p1_source_batch', p1_source_batch, 'p1_source_row_type', COALESCE(p1_source_row_type, source_row_type), 'p1_metric_values', jsonb_build_object('avg_monthly_searches', p1_avg_monthly_searches, 'competition', p1_competition, 'competition_index', p1_competition_index, 'bid_currency', p1_bid_currency, 'low_bid', p1_low_bid, 'high_bid', p1_high_bid), 'current_bank', jsonb_build_object('review_status', current_bank_review_status, 'bank_bucket', current_bank_bucket, 'page_type', current_page_type, 'visible_in_listing_master', current_visible_in_listing_master), 'proposed_insert_allowed', proposed_insert_allowed_calc, 'proposed_score', proposed_score_calc, 'insert_payload_excludes_bid_fields', true)) AS raw_json

                    WHEN ((b.kw ~ '(headpiece|crown|headdress)'::text) AND (b.part_l !~ '(headpiece)'::text) AND (b.components_l !~ '(headpiece|crown|headdress)'::text)) THEN 'blocked_headpiece_not_component'::text
                    WHEN ((b.kw ~ '(^|[^a-z0-9])mask([^a-z0-9]|$)'::text) AND (b.part_l !~ 'mask'::text) AND (b.components_l !~ 'mask'::text)) THEN 'blocked_mask_not_component'::text
                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(theatre|theater|opera|sports|cultural festival|seasonal peaks)'::text) THEN 'blocked_event_not_canon'::text
                    WHEN ((b.kw ~ 'warrior'::text) AND (COALESCE(b.persona_l, ''::text) <> 'warrior'::text) AND (b.product_text !~ 'warrior'::text)) THEN 'blocked_warrior_not_persona'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS blocked_reason,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'top'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(top|corset|bra top|breastplate|chest plate)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'harness'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'harness'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'skirt'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'skirt'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'mask'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'mask'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'headpiece'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(headpiece|crown|headdress)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'bodysuit'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'bodysuit'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'dress'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'dress'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'shoulders'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(shoulder|shoulders)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'arms'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(arm|arms|glove|bracelet|bracer)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.part_l = 'legs'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(leg|legs|garter|garters)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.components_l ~ '(top|corset|skirt|mask|headpiece|crown|harness|shoulder|arm|leg|garter|glove|choker|belt|panties|bodysuit)'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(top|corset|skirt|mask|headpiece|crown|harness|shoulder|arm|leg|garter|glove|choker|belt|panties|bodysuit)'::text)) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS part_component_match,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.material_l ~ '(mirror acrylic|acrylic)'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(mirror|acrylic|reflective)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.material_l ~ 'vegan leather'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(vegan leather|leather|harness)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.material_l ~ 'fabric'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'fabric'::text)) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS material_match,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.color_l <> ''::text) AND (b.kw ~~ (('%'::text || b.color_l) || '%'::text))) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS color_match,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.context_l = 'burning man'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'burning man'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.context_l = 'festival/rave'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(festival|rave|edm|edc|coachella|tomorrowland|club)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.context_l = 'stage/performance'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(stage|performance|dance|drag|burlesque|show|dj)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.context_l = 'fashion/editorial/red carpet'::text) AND (b.kw ~ '(fashion|editorial|red carpet)'::text)) THEN true
                    WHEN ((b.context_l = 'cosplay'::text) AND (b.kw ~ 'cosplay'::text)) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS context_match,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((b.persona_l <> ''::text) AND (b.kw ~~ (('%'::text || b.persona_l) || '%'::text))) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS persona_match,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(outfit|costume|festival|rave|burning man|stage|performance|cosplay|drag|dance)'::text) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS collection_intent,
                CASE
                    WHEN (b.kw ~ '(gold|silver|black|white|red|holographic|mirror|acrylic|vegan leather|leather|metallic|futuristic|cyberpunk|goth|punk)'::text) THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS image_alt_intent
           FROM base b
        ), final AS (
         SELECT s.brief_queue_id,
            s.canonical_product_id,
            s.product_slug,
            s.current_title,
            s.product_title,
            s.card_title,
            s.h1,
            s.matched_etsy_listing_id,
            s.source_listing_id,
            s.source_url,
            s.product_type,
            s.part,
            s.part_subtype,
            s.material,

            s.color,
            s.color_detail,
            s.context_primary,
            s.context_secondary,
            s.persona,
            s.gender,
            s.components,
            s.product_text,
            s.keyword_metric_status,
            s.product_fact_quality_status,
            s.product_fact_warning_codes_json,
            s.safe_generation_status,
            s.priority_order,
            s.evaluated_at,
            s.keyword_id,
            s.keyword,
            s.keyword_norm,
            s.keyword_axis,
            s.keyword_pattern,
            s.suggested_page_level,
            s.evidence_count,
            s.source_count,
            s.has_metric_snapshot,
            s.resolved_metric_status,
            s.source_codes_json,
            s.kw,
            s.part_l,
            s.material_l,
            s.color_l,
            s.context_l,
            s.context_secondary_l,
            s.persona_l,
            s.components_l,
            s.blocked_reason,
            s.part_component_match,
            s.material_match,
            s.color_match,
            s.context_match,
            s.persona_match,
            s.collection_intent,
            s.image_alt_intent,
                CASE
                    WHEN (s.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL) THEN 'blocked'::text
                    WHEN (s.part_component_match AND (s.material_match OR s.color_match OR s.context_match OR s.persona_match)) THEN 'strong_fit'::text
                    WHEN s.part_component_match THEN 'medium_fit'::text
                    WHEN (s.collection_intent AND s.context_match) THEN 'collection_fit'::text
                    WHEN (s.image_alt_intent AND (s.material_match OR s.color_match)) THEN 'image_alt_fit'::text
                    ELSE 'needs_review'::text
                END AS fit_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN (s.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL) THEN 0
                    ELSE ((((((
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.part_component_match THEN 40
                        ELSE 0
                    END +
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.material_match THEN 15
                        ELSE 0
                    END) +
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.color_match THEN 15
                        ELSE 0
                    END) +
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.context_match THEN 10
                        ELSE 0
                    END) +
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.persona_match THEN 10
                        ELSE 0
                    END) + LEAST(15, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(s.evidence_count, 0)))) +
                    CASE
                        WHEN (s.product_fact_quality_status = 'HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text) THEN '-10'::integer
                        WHEN (s.product_fact_quality_status = 'FACT_WARNINGS'::text) THEN '-5'::integer
                        ELSE 0
                    END)
                END AS fit_score_pre_metric,
                CASE
                    WHEN (s.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL) THEN 'none'::text
                    WHEN s.part_component_match THEN 'product'::text
                    WHEN s.collection_intent THEN 'collection'::text
                    WHEN s.image_alt_intent THEN 'image_alt'::text
                    ELSE COALESCE(s.suggested_page_level, 'needs_review'::text)
                END AS page_level_recommendation,
                CASE
                    WHEN (s.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL) THEN 'blocked'::text
                    WHEN (s.product_fact_quality_status = ANY (ARRAY['HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text, 'FACT_WARNINGS'::text])) THEN 'needs_fact_review'::text
                    ELSE 'compatible_candidate'::text
                END AS compatibility_status,
            ((s.blocked_reason IS NOT NULL) OR (s.product_fact_quality_status = ANY (ARRAY['HIGH_RISK_FACT_REVIEW'::text, 'FACT_WARNINGS'::text]))) AS needs_human_review
           FROM scored s
        )
 SELECT canonical_product_id,
    product_slug,
    product_title,
    h1,
    card_title,
    source_listing_id,
    matched_etsy_listing_id,
    product_type,
    part,
    part_subtype,
    material,
    material_detail,
    color_detail AS color,
    context_primary,
    context_secondary,
    persona,
    gender,
    components,
    NULL::text AS page_goal,
    keyword_id,
    keyword,
    keyword_norm,
    keyword_axis,
    keyword_pattern,
    suggested_page_level,
    evidence_count,
    source_count,
    has_metric_snapshot,
    resolved_metric_status AS metric_status,
    fit_status,
    fit_score_pre_metric,
    page_level_recommendation,
    compatibility_status,
    blocked_reason,
    needs_human_review,
    jsonb_build_object('part_component_match', part_component_match, 'material_match', material_match, 'color_match', color_match, 'context_match', context_match, 'persona_match', persona_match, 'collection_intent', collection_intent, 'image_alt_intent', image_alt_intent, 'product_fact_quality_status', product_fact_quality_status, 'formula', 'part_component +40, material +15, color +15, context +10, persona +10, evidence up to +15, fact warning -5/-10, blocked=0') AS fit_reason,
    evaluated_at
   FROM final;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feya_commerce_apply_seo_keyword_metric_import_v1(p_batch_code text, p_source_file_name text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(inserted_snapshots integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_inserted integer;
begin
  insert into public.feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1 (
    keyword_norm,
    source_api,
    geo,
    language,
    avg_monthly_searches,
    competition,
    competition_index,
    low_top_of_page_bid,
    high_top_of_page_bid,
    monthly_search_volumes_json,
    fetched_at,
    raw_payload_json,
    data_freshness_status
  )
  select
    r.keyword_norm,
    'manual_keyword_metrics_import' as source_api,
    r.geo,
    r.language,
    r.avg_monthly_searches,
    r.competition,
    r.competition_index,
    r.low_top_of_page_bid,
    r.high_top_of_page_bid,
    case
      when nullif(btrim(r.monthly_search_volumes_raw), '') is null then null::jsonb
      when btrim(r.monthly_search_volumes_raw) ~ '^\s*[\[{]' then r.monthly_search_volumes_raw::jsonb
      else jsonb_build_object('raw', r.monthly_search_volumes_raw)
    end as monthly_search_volumes_json,
    now() as fetched_at,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'batch_code', r.batch_code,
      'keyword', r.keyword,
      'keyword_norm', r.keyword_norm,
      'source_file_name', r.source_file_name,
      'imported_at', r.imported_at,
      'import_status', r.import_status,
      'import_note', r.import_note,
      'bridge', 'manual_validation_export_import_v1'
    ) as raw_payload_json,
    'fresh_manual_import' as data_freshness_status
  from public.feya_commerce_v_seo_keyword_metric_import_ready_v1 r
  where r.batch_code = p_batch_code
    and (p_source_file_name is null or r.source_file_name = p_source_file_name);

  get diagnostics v_inserted = row_count;
  return query select v_inserted;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feya_commerce_fn_promote_keyword_metric_import_v1(p_batch_code text)
 RETURNS TABLE(batch_code text, normalized_rows integer, inserted_snapshots integer, updated_staging_rows integer, skipped_rows integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare
  v_normalized integer := 0;
  v_inserted integer := 0;
  v_updated integer := 0;
  v_skipped integer := 0;
begin
  update public.feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1 s
  set keyword_norm = lower(trim(s.keyword)),
      import_status = coalesce(nullif(s.import_status, ''), 'pending')
  where s.batch_code = p_batch_code
    and (s.keyword_norm is null or btrim(s.keyword_norm) = '')
    and s.keyword is not null;
  get diagnostics v_normalized = row_count;

  insert into public.feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1 (
    keyword_norm,
    source_api,
    geo,
    language,
    avg_monthly_searches,
    competition,
    competition_index,
    low_top_of_page_bid,
    high_top_of_page_bid,
    monthly_search_volumes_json,
    fetched_at,
    raw_payload_json,
    data_freshness_status
  )
  select
    lower(trim(s.keyword_norm)) as keyword_norm,
    'google_ads_csv'::text as source_api,
    coalesce(nullif(s.geo, ''), 'US') as geo,
    coalesce(nullif(s.language, ''), 'en') as language,
    s.avg_monthly_searches,
    nullif(s.competition, '') as competition,
    s.competition_index,
    s.low_top_of_page_bid,
    s.high_top_of_page_bid,
    case
      when s.monthly_search_volumes_raw is not null and btrim(s.monthly_search_volumes_raw) <> ''
        then jsonb_build_object('raw', s.monthly_search_volumes_raw)
      else null::jsonb
    end as monthly_search_volumes_json,
    now() as fetched_at,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'batch_code', s.batch_code,
      'source_file_name', s.source_file_name,
      'import_row_id', s.import_row_id,
      'imported_at', s.imported_at
    ) as raw_payload_json,
    'fresh_manual_import'::text as data_freshness_status
  from public.feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1 s
  where s.batch_code = p_batch_code
    and s.keyword_norm is not null
    and btrim(s.keyword_norm) <> ''
    and s.avg_monthly_searches is not null
    and coalesce(s.import_status, 'pending') not in ('promoted_to_snapshots', 'error')
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_snapshots_v1 m
      where m.keyword_norm = lower(trim(s.keyword_norm))
        and m.geo = coalesce(nullif(s.geo, ''), 'US')
        and m.language = coalesce(nullif(s.language, ''), 'en')
        and m.source_api = 'google_ads_csv'
        and m.raw_payload_json ->> 'batch_code' = s.batch_code
    );
  get diagnostics v_inserted = row_count;

  update public.feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1 s
  set import_status = case
        when s.keyword_norm is null or btrim(s.keyword_norm) = '' then 'error'
        when s.avg_monthly_searches is null then 'error'
        else 'promoted_to_snapshots'
      end,
      import_note = case
        when s.keyword_norm is null or btrim(s.keyword_norm) = '' then 'Missing keyword_norm / keyword.'
        when s.avg_monthly_searches is null then 'Missing avg_monthly_searches; row was not promoted.'
        else 'Promoted to metric snapshots by feya_commerce_fn_promote_keyword_metric_import_v1.'
      end
  where s.batch_code = p_batch_code
    and coalesce(s.import_status, 'pending') not in ('promoted_to_snapshots', 'error');
  get diagnostics v_updated = row_count;

  select count(*)::int
  into v_skipped
  from public.feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1 s
  where s.batch_code = p_batch_code
    and s.import_status = 'error';

  return query select p_batch_code, v_normalized, v_inserted, v_updated, v_skipped;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feya_fn_apply_manual_keyword_metrics_v1(p_batch_code text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(updated_rows integer, matched_candidates integer, batch_filter text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
declare
  v_updated integer := 0;
  v_matched integer := 0;
begin
  with latest_metric as (
    select distinct on (s.keyword_norm)
      s.keyword_norm,
      s.batch_code,
      s.geo,
      s.language,
      s.avg_monthly_searches,
      s.competition,
      s.competition_index,
      s.low_top_of_page_bid,
      s.high_top_of_page_bid,
      s.imported_at
    from public.feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1 s
    where s.keyword_norm is not null
      and (p_batch_code is null or s.batch_code = p_batch_code)
    order by s.keyword_norm, s.imported_at desc nulls last, s.import_row_id desc
  )
  select count(*)::int into v_matched
  from public.feya_manual_keyword_candidate_v1 c
  join latest_metric m on m.keyword_norm = c.keyword_norm;

  with latest_metric as (
    select distinct on (s.keyword_norm)
      s.keyword_norm,
      s.batch_code,
      s.geo,
      s.language,
      s.avg_monthly_searches,
      s.competition,
      s.competition_index,
      s.low_top_of_page_bid,
      s.high_top_of_page_bid,
      s.imported_at
    from public.feya_commerce_seo_keyword_metric_import_staging_v1 s
    where s.keyword_norm is not null
      and (p_batch_code is null or s.batch_code = p_batch_code)
    order by s.keyword_norm, s.imported_at desc nulls last, s.import_row_id desc
  )
  update public.feya_manual_keyword_candidate_v1 c
  set avg_monthly_searches = m.avg_monthly_searches,
      competition = m.competition,
      competition_index = m.competition_index,
      low_top_of_page_bid = m.low_top_of_page_bid,
      high_top_of_page_bid = m.high_top_of_page_bid,
      metric_geo = m.geo,
      metric_language = m.language,
      metric_batch_code = m.batch_code,
      metric_imported_at = coalesce(m.imported_at, now()),
      metrics_status = 'has_metric_import',
      candidate_status = case when c.candidate_status = 'draft' then 'metric_imported' else c.candidate_status end,
      updated_at = now()
  from latest_metric m
  where c.keyword_norm = m.keyword_norm;

  get diagnostics v_updated = row_count;
  return query select v_updated, v_matched, coalesce(p_batch_code, 'ALL_BATCHES');
end;
